mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.inventory_id AS inventoryId, l.lock_room_count AS roomCount, l.lock_status AS status FROM inventory_lock_record l JOIN room_type_inventory i ON i.id = l.inventory_id WHERE l.order_id = #{orderId} AND l.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY i.stay_date, l.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_lock_record SET lock_status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND lock_status = 'locked'
